critical_code_review_comments: Profanity filter is client-side only (as expected for a static frontend on ntfy pub/sub); other clients on a different Flint build could still send raw text and bypass censoring on their end — filter is applied both on outgoing send and on displayed bubbles so this build is safe; noted for awareness only.
Chat pruning of test messages relies on topic rotation. Consider documenting the rotation policy in ch4t.html header comment for future maintainers.
